subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to make the whole story. Only
stimulus: the corresponding numbers of the sentences need to be written. 1×8= 8 (a) He said to himself, “One thousand rupees is a lot of money.” (b) The farmer was surprised. (c) The rich man went to the farmer with one thousand rupees in a bag. (d) He said to him, “Look, my friend! I have brought one thousand rupees for you.” (e) “Keep this money and remove your distress.” (f) He took the bag of money from the rich man and thanked him. (g) He did not find any safe place to keep the bag. (h) He could not think where to keep the money.
guide_solution: The parts of the story can appear in the following order: 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 c d e b f a h g
